a: Track 1 (EAGER): $100,000-$400,000 for up to 2 years; Track 2: up to $2,000,000 over 4 years; $15M per fiscal year, up to 15 awards per year
dt: Required two-page concept outline by email to EFRI2027-2028@nsf.gov by Nov 19, 2026, 5 pm local time; full proposals, by program officer invitation only, due Feb 11, 2027, 5 pm local time. FY 2028 cycle: outline by Nov 16, 2027, full proposal by Feb 10, 2028.
e: Funds research on computing with waves (photonic, acoustic and other platforms, including nonlinear and quantum approaches; spin-wave computing is out of scope) through 2-year exploratory EAGER grants and 4-year grants to teams of three or more investigators. US universities and non-profits may apply; at a university the lead PI must be full-time tenured or tenure-track faculty, the PI or a co-PI must hold a tenured or tenure-track post in an engineering college or department, each person may be on only one proposal per fiscal year, and there is no citizenship restriction.
